blocks.html: Egress path markings shall be provided in interior exit stairways, interior exit ramps and exit passageways, in accordance with Sections 1025.2.1 through 1025.2.9. Entrances to interior exit stairways, interior exit ramps and exit passageways shall be provided with exit signs in compliance with Section 1025.2.6.1.
